## Summary

The bug was a single off-by-one in `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts:16`: `PostController.index` called `Post.newQuery().orderBy('id', 'desc').paginate({ page: page + 1, perPage: 10 })`, but `page` from `ListPostsQuerySchema` is already 1-based (defaulting to `1`). So a request for page 1 fetched the ORM's page 2 (posts 11–20), page 2 fetched page 3 (21–25), and page 3 fetched a nonexistent page 4 (empty) — exactly matching the reported symptoms, including new posts never appearing since they always land in the never-requested first page. Fixed by passing `page` straight through: `.paginate({ page, perPage: 10 })`. The frontend (`resources/js/pages/posts/Index.tsx`) renders pager links straight from the backend's `pagination.links`/`meta` with no client-side math, so no frontend change was needed.

I also expanded `tests/PostController.test.ts` with a `posts.index` suite (25 seeded posts) asserting page 1/2/3 contents by id, pager `meta` (currentPage/from/to/lastPage) and `links` (prev/next), and that all 25 posts appear exactly once across the three pages. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (7/7 pass), and `bunx guren check` all pass.
